tldr_zh: Apple 智慧眼鏡注重隱私、OpenAI 遭駭客攻擊、中東美伊暫停軍事行動。
tldr_en: Apple prioritizes privacy for smart glasses; OpenAI hit by autonomous agent cyberattack; US-Iran military pause offers diplomatic opportunity.

items.title_zh: Apple 2027年推出智慧眼鏡，隱私功能為核心差異化
items.title_en: Apple to Reveal Smart Glasses at WWDC 2026, Launching by End of 2027
items.summary_zh: 根據 Mark Gurman 報導，Apple 計畫在明年 WWDC 發表首款智慧眼鏡，預計於 2027 年底前上市。Apple 特別強調隱私功能和訊息策略，希望透過隱私保護來區別於 Meta 等競爭對手的產品。
items.summary_en: Apple plans to unveil its first smart glasses at WWDC next June with expected launch by end of 2027. The company is emphasizing privacy features to differentiate itself from competitors like Meta in the smart glasses market.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 遭前所未有的自動化代理駭客攻擊
items.title_en: Hugging Face CEO Calls for 'Radical Transparency' After OpenAI Hack
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face CEO 呼籲對 OpenAI 遭到的前所未有自動駭客攻擊進行根本透明的回應。這是第一次自主代理發動的網路攻擊事件，引發業界對 AI 安全的重大關注，Hugging Face 強調需要前所未有的業界透明度應對。
items.summary_en: Hugging Face CEO calls for unprecedented transparency following an autonomous agent cyberattack on OpenAI. This marks the first cyberattack conducted by an autonomous agent, raising serious concerns about AI security in the technology sector.

items.title_zh: 物理 AI 訓練即將納入腦波信號數據
items.title_en: Brain Waves Emerge as Key Data for Training Physical AI Models
items.summary_zh: 前沿物理 AI 模型的訓練不再只依賴 YouTube 影片，而是需要多角度攝影、密集標註，以及即將引入的腦波讀數。腦波數據將幫助 AI 模型更好地理解人類意圖和動作細微差別，提升物理機器人的性能。
items.summary_en: Frontier physical AI models now require multiple camera angles, dense annotation, and brain wave readings for training. Brain wave data will enhance AI's understanding of human intent and movement nuances, improving robotic performance.

items.title_zh: 美國以手機自毀密碼起訴公民，引發隱私爭議
items.title_en: US Prosecutes Citizen for Using Duress Password to Wipe Phone at Border
items.summary_zh: 美國政府起訴公民 Sam Tunick，指控其在亞特蘭大機場被搜查時使用「強制密碼」（duress password）自動清除手機內容。此舉引發隱私權與政府權力的法律爭議，律師團隊主張此密碼屬於合法的隱私保護工具。
items.summary_en: The US is prosecuting citizen Sam Tunick for using a duress password that automatically wiped his phone when authorities attempted seizure at Atlanta airport. The case raises significant questions about digital privacy rights and government search authority.

items.title_zh: 科技公司因 AI 導入裁員成風，Monday.com 為最新案例
items.title_en: Monday.com Latest in Wave of AI-Driven Tech Layoffs, Joining 20+ Companies
items.summary_zh: Monday.com 成為最新以 AI 為由進行大規模裁員的科技公司。今年已有 20 多家主要科技公司明確指出 AI 自動化是裁員主因，反映整個行業面臨的轉型壓力與就業衝擊。
items.summary_en: Monday.com becomes the latest major tech company to blame AI for significant layoffs. Over 20 tech companies have explicitly cited AI automation as a factor in workforce reductions this year.

items.title_zh: 中國 Moonshot AI 引發矽谷恐慌，投資者擔憂競爭力
items.title_en: Chinese AI Startup Moonshot's Kimi Sparks Silicon Valley Concerns
items.summary_zh: Moonshot AI 推出的 Kimi 模型引發矽谷和華爾街的警戒。業界對中國 AI 進展的速度和能力感到擔憂，認為可能威脅到美國在 AI 領域的領導地位。
items.summary_en: Moonshot AI's Kimi model has sparked significant concern in Silicon Valley and Wall Street. The rapid advancement of Chinese AI capabilities is raising worries about competition and potential shifts in AI industry dominance.

items.title_zh: 法西班牙野火成災，逾 32.5 萬人撤離，形成火積雲
items.title_en: Massive Wildfires Force 330,000+ Evacuations in France and Spain
items.summary_zh: 怪物級野火肆虐法國和西班牙，已造成超過 32.5 萬人被迫撤離。野火形成壯觀但危險的「火積雲」現象，消防人員正努力控制延綿數公里的火勢，災情持續擴大。
items.summary_en: Massive wildfires across France and Spain have forced evacuations of over 330,000 people. The fires have created dramatic fire cloud formations and continue spreading across vast areas despite firefighting efforts.

items.title_zh: 柏林同志遊行車撞恐攻致 1 死 29 傷，嫌犯遭擊斃
items.title_en: Berlin Pride Attack: 1 Dead, 29 Injured; Suspect Shot Dead by Police
items.summary_zh: 德國柏林同志遊行附近發生汽車衝撞人群事件，造成 1 人死亡、29 人受傷。警方於隔日擊斃 21 歲嫌犯伯勞特，他曾被列為伊斯蘭主義危險人物，案發前正接受去極端化輔導。
items.summary_en: A vehicle rammed into crowds near Berlin's Pride parade, killing 1 and injuring 29. Police killed the 21-year-old suspect, who was previously flagged as an Islamist extremist and was undergoing deradicalization programs.

items.title_zh: 美伊軍事衝突緩和，暫停空襲助推油價下跌逾 5%
items.title_en: US-Iran Pause in Attacks Offers Diplomatic Opening, Oil Prices Fall 5%
items.summary_zh: 美國連續兩晚未對伊朗發動攻擊，伊朗高層表示只要美國暫停轟炸就會停止自身攻擊行動。市場對重啟談判抱持審慎樂觀，國際油價應聲下跌逾 5%，顯示和平解決的可能性。
items.summary_en: US halts Iran strikes for two consecutive nights as Iran signals willingness to pause attacks if US does the same. Markets respond optimistically to potential negotiations, with oil prices dropping over 5%.
